decision_rules.completeness: Correctly include every authored expected claim. Unsupported added claims are counted under citation support/uncertainty, not automatically as missing expected claims.
decision_rules.attribution: Correct entity assignment; no project swap inferred solely from an unsupported extra statement or a bad citation.
decision_rules.citation_support: All substantive claims and source scopes must be supported by cited excerpts. Out-of-range labels fail. Whole-context claims cannot be established by one unrelated source.
decision_rules.uncertainty: Do not invent missing policies, treat explicit requirements as merely optional/unknown, or declare a complete requested comparison unavailable because unrelated facts are missing. Correctly scoped abstention may pass even if its citation fails.
decision_rules.scope_caveats: Brevity, layout, and supported but unrequested facts remain qualitative notes; no new scored dimension is introduced after inspecting results.
